Item.Name: CONTRACT_ID
Item.Hint: Enter value for Contract ID or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cnt number ;
begin
nullchk ;
check_package_failure ;
begin
 select company into :company
 from contracts
 where contract_id=:control_block.contract_id
 and contract_type = 'PT'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 NEXT_ITEM ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select count(*) into cnt
 from contracts
 where contract_type = 'PT'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and upper(company) like '%'||upper(:control_block.contract_id)||'%'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 if cnt = 0 then
 show_error('1147') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif cnt = 1 then
 select contract_id,company
 into :control_block.contract_id,:company
 from contracts
 where contract_type = 'PT'
 and upper(company) like
 '%'||upper(:control_block.contract_id)||'%'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 else
 list_values ;
 end if ;
 end ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;
end ;

Item.Name: S_TEST_ID
Item.Hint: Enter a Test ID or press [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 select pbh.test_id,test_desc
 into :s_test_id, :test_desc
 from pt_batch_hdr pbh, valid_tests vt
 where pbh.test_id = :s_test_id
 and pbh.batch_id = :control_block.batch_id
 and pbh.test_id = vt.test_id
 and sysdate between vt.eff_date and nvl(vt.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and rownum = 1 ;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1227') ; check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;

Block.Name: PT_BATCH_DET
Block.WhereClause: where batch_id = :control_block.batch_id and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and test_id = :s_test_id

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_tb_id varchar2(14) ;
begin
 begin
 select result_status_1, absorbance, tb_id, result_user_id
 into :act_result, :act_absorbance, v_tb_id, :result_user_id
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and test_id = :control_block.s_test_id
 and test_seq_no = :test_seq_no ;
 select cut_off_value into :act_cut_off
 from test_batch_det
 where tb_id = v_tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and test_id = :control_block.s_test_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error; check_package_failure ;
end ;
if (:act_result is not null and
 :exp_result is not null and
 :act_result != :exp_result) or
 (:act_absorbance is not null and
 :exp_absorbance is not null and
 :act_absorbance != :exp_absorbance) then
 :dev_cnt := :dev_cnt + 1 ;
end if ;
if (:act_result is not null and :exp_result is not null) or
 (:act_absorbance is not null and :exp_absorbance is not null) then
 :tot_cnt := :tot_cnt + 1 ;
end if ;

-- Added by HCL-C to calculate check digit
:pt_batch_det.chk_digit := 
 chk_digit_query(:pt_batch_det.unit_id,null,:control_block.s_chapter_id);
 check_package_failure;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_SUMMARY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure populate_summary is
begin
 if :tot_cnt = 0 then
 select null,null,null into :tot_cnt,:dev_cnt,:percent_match
 from dual ;
 else
 :percent_match :=((:tot_cnt - :dev_cnt) / :tot_cnt) * 100 ;
 end if ;
end ;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_S_TEST_ID_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select pt_batch_hdr.test_id, substr(test_desc,1,30) from pt_batch_hdr, valid_tests where batch_id = :control_block.batch_id and valid_tests.test_id = pt_batch_hdr.test_id and sysdate between valid_tests.eff_date and nvl(valid_tests.term_date,sysdate+1) order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_BATCH_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct pt.batch_id from pt_batch_hdr pt, batch_inputs bu where pt.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and pt.batch_id = bu.batch_id and bu.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and bu.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id order by 1 desc

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CONTRACT_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select contract_id,company, unit_id_pattern from contracts where substr(contract_id,4,2) = 'PT' and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and (contract_id = :control_block.contract_id or upper(company) like '%'||upper(:control_block.contract_id)||'%') and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) order by contract_id
